Headline: #54 Cicero Temporary Reroute near Cicero/19th
ShortDescription: #54 Cicero buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, police activity near Cicero/19th.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#54 Cicero buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Cicero, 16th, Kostner, Cermak, and Cicero then resume their normal route, due to police activity near Cicero/19th.

Allow extra travel time.
